# Asana — Asana for Startups Discount Program

A partner-issued discount code applied to a Starter or Advanced annual plan for the first 12 months of the subscription. No discount percentage or amount is published.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [📋 Productivity & Ops](../categories/productivity.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Offer is non-transferable. Limit one offer redemption per customer. |
| **When it ends** | After the Discounted Period, your account will be billed at Asana's then-current pricing, as set forth on Asana's plans page. |


### Not covered

- organizations currently on paid plans
- organizations that upgraded to a paid plan within the last 60 days
- plans other than Starter or Advanced annual

> **Stacking:** Asana may amend or revoke this promotional offer at any time in its sole discretion for organizations that have not yet redeemed the discount code.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

No discount percentage or dollar value is published anywhere on the page, so amount_is_published is false. The offer cannot be self-served: the redemption steps require a code 'you have been given by an existing partner', hence partner_gate required-hard. The 'Claim my discount' CTA resolves to https://asa.na/offer, which redirects to app.asana.com's login/upgrade flow with a coupon parameter; apply_url is set to the program page itself since the code must be obtained from a partner first. Series A or earlier is the stated stage cap; no funding, revenue or headcount figures are published.
